predictions.rationale: Central class representing Deployment diagrams in the main application package; core implementation of the diagram feature.
UI action that lets the user create/open a Deployment diagram; directly triggers feature use.
Graph model defining the nodes/edges for Deployment diagrams; essential for runtime architecture representation.
Renderer responsible for visualizing nodes and artifacts on Deployment diagrams.
Initialisation class that registers the Deployment diagram and its components with the application.
Property panel specific to Deployment diagrams; supports editing diagram-level properties.
Alternative/extended implementation of Deployment diagrams provided by the deployment2 module.
Factory that creates Deployment diagram instances in the newer deployment2 subsystem.
Graph model counterpart in the deployment2 module; defines runtime architecture elements.
Figure class for components on a Deployment diagram; directly supports visual representation of software artifacts.
